Are you interested in shaping your career in Finance within a global company? Join Arla Foods as a Finance Graduate in Denmark, Sweden, or Germany, where you will develop your skills, gain international experience, and drive business impact. As part of a dynamic Finance organisation, you'll contribute to sustainability efforts and help shape the future of Finance using cutting-edge digital technologies and data.

About our Finance Graduate Programme

The Finance Graduate Programme is a 2-year programme consisting of three rotations across our global Finance organisation. You'll enhance your core finance skills and develop essential competencies in Business & Performance, Data & Digital, and Strategy & Execution. Throughout the programme, you will be exposed to key finance disciplines while developing your strategic, personal, and professional skills to ensure you have the capabilities needed to succeed in the future of Finance.

We are looking for graduates to join in Denmark, Sweden, and Germany, and as part of the programme, you will have a 6-month rotation abroad in one of our European offices. Your Finance Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027, where you will be hired on a permanent employment contract from day one and will continue your career within Finance in Arla Foods after finishing the 2-year graduate programme.

How will you make an impact as a Finance Graduate?

As a Finance Graduate, you will be a part of a highly competent Finance organisation contributing to both daily operations and cross-functional projects to drive the business forward. You will get your own areas of responsibility, enabling on-the-job learning, and you will get to explore the following areas within Finance

• Business & Performance (12 months – home country) You will apply analytical skills to provide guidance for decision-makers and develop a strong understanding of financial performance through analysis and modeling, while enhancing your ability to influence others

• Data & Digital (6 months – home country or abroad) You will leverage data to generate insights, grow advanced analytics and visualization skills, and apply digital technology to automate and optimize tasks for efficiency

• Strategy & Execution (6 months – home country or abroad) You will build and communicate business cases for investments, engage in problem solving and stakeholder management, and use finance to drive business growth and create value

What will make you a successful Finance Graduate?

To apply for the Finance Graduate Programme, please ensure that you can tick off the following boxes

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree from a university by September 2027 or have graduated within the last 2 years. We are open to various educational backgrounds, so what truly matters is your interest in Finance and curious mindset

• Minimum 1 year of relevant experience from work and/or extracurricular activities

• Being professionally fluent in English

• Currently residing in, or willing to relocate to, either Denmark, Sweden or Germany, and being internationally mobile for at least 6 months as part of the programme

In addition, we are looking for graduates who

• Lead with confidence, make independent decisions, are results-oriented while valuing the journey to achieve those outcomes

• Build positive relationships with a collaborative mindset and are open to feedback

• Communicate complex information clearly and effectively

• Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn and explore

• Use an analytical and structured approach to problem-solving with a proactive attitude

Why join Arla’s Finance Graduate Programme?

As part of our Finance Graduate Programme, you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from

• Responsibilities from day one enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas

• Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues

• One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders

• Supportive graduate community across our graduate programmes

Important information before application

The application period for the Finance Graduate Programme runs from November 2nd 2026 to January 3rd 2027. Before applying, please make sure that you have already prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked different questions on the application page, thus we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone or tablet.

For additional information, read more about the Finance Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current graduates and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Curious about how technology powers everything we do at Arla Foods, from farm to fridge? Join our IT Graduate Programme and kickstart your career with hands-on experience, real projects, and guidance from experienced colleagues and mentors.

Over two years and two rotations, you’ll build a strong foundation in IT & Digital, develop your ability to work closely with the business, and gain broad experience across our organisation while helping shape the digital future of Arla.

About our IT Graduate Programme

The IT Graduate Programme is a two-year opportunity designed to kickstart your career after graduation. Through two different rotations, you’ll gain a broad and well-rounded experience across Arla’s IT & Digital organisation, build your professional and personal skills, and explore different areas of IT & Digital.

The programme opens up broad career possibilities and will help prepare you for future opportunities within Arla IT & Digital after completing the programme.

“The IT Graduate Programme provides a unique opportunity to experience different areas of the business, build a strong network, and grow both professionally and personally. Besides building your technical skills, each rotation also offers a new perspective on the business, helping you understand how different teams collaborate to create value. The strong support network of mentors, buddies, development managers, and fellow graduates makes the journey both rewarding and fun, while helping you build connections across the entire organisation”, says Gergana Biserova Atanasova, IT Graduate in IT&Digital Foundation Operational Technology Infrastructure.

How will you make an impact as an IT Graduate?

As an IT Graduate, you’ll become part of a highly competent and diverse IT & Digital organisation, contributing to both daily operations and projects that help move our global business forward.

Throughout the programme, your two rotations will give you different perspectives and opportunities to develop

First rotation

Before joining Arla, you’ll already know where your graduate journey will begin and who your manager will be. Your first rotation will focus on building a strong foundation in core IT & Digital capabilities.

• Depending on your role, this could mean working with data to identify trends or improve reporting, supporting the development or implementation of an IT solution, helping strengthen the reliability or security of our systems, improving an existing digital process, or contributing to a technical project together with experienced colleagues.

Second rotation

Your second rotation will focus on developing your business co-creation skills, giving you the opportunity to work closely with the business and strengthen your stakeholder engagement capabilities. You’ll see how Arla’s IT & Digital organisation supports the business from end to end, including areas such as Supply Chain, Commercial and Cross-functions.

• Here, the challenge might be understanding a problem faced by colleagues in Supply Chain, Commercial or Cross-functions and helping shape a technology solution, exploring how a manual process could be automated, using data to support better decision-making, or helping introduce a new digital solution for users across the business.

As part of your graduate journey, we’ll provide you with broad and well-rounded experience across Arla’s IT & Digital organisation. Your rotations could take you into areas such as data science, solutions consultancy, network consultancy, cybersecurity, or others.

By experiencing different parts of IT & Digital, you’ll start to understand not only the technology behind a global organisation, but also the people and business needs it supports. You’ll leave the programme with broader experience, a strong network and a clearer understanding of where you want to take your career at Arla.

What will make you a successful IT Graduate?

We’re looking for curious, motivated individuals with a genuine interest in IT and a strong desire to learn and grow. While we welcome graduates from diverse educational backgrounds, your mindset and motivation matter most.

You are

• Aspiring to build a career in IT

• Living in Denmark

• Holding a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a STEM field, completed within two years before the programme starts in September 2027

• Analytical and structured in your approach, with strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn, explore, and take on new challenges

• Curious about how technology and digital solutions can support and create value for the business

• Open to new people and perspectives, comfortable communicating with others, and motivated to be an active part of the graduate community

Why join Arla’s IT Graduate Programme?

As part of our IT Graduate Programme, you’ll receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To support your professional and personal development, you’ll benefit from

• 
Responsibilities from day one, enabling on-the-job learning across two different rotations

• 
Graduate development camps taking place in different markets together with your graduate colleagues

• 
One-to-one mentoring and sparring with senior leaders

• 
A supportive graduate community across Arla’s graduate programmes

• 
Exposure to different areas of IT & Digital and opportunities to collaborate with colleagues across our global business

Important information before applying

Join Arla’s IT & Digital Graduate Programme and take the first step towards a meaningful, dynamic career in a global company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth.

The application period for the IT Graduate Programme runs from 2nd November 2026 to 3rd January 2027.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**This is a hands-on role responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial information, overseeing the month-end close, management accounts, financial reporting and statutory compliance, while continuously improving financial processes, systems and internal controls and working closely with Senior Management, external service providers and the wider business teams. The role will combine strong technical accounting expertise with a proactive, solutions-focused approach and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the monthly and annual close – reviewing journals, accruals, prepayments, provisions and balance sheet reconciliations, and delivering accurate trial balances and financial statements on time

• Make sure our SaaS revenue (subscription, usage-based and implementation) is recognised correctly, and reconcile revenue schedules to billing, contracts and the general ledger

• Produce reliable monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reporting

• Take over revenue billing from the sales team and run it within finance

• Manage our outsourced service providers and review the reconciliations they prepare – bank, intercompany, payroll, fixed assets and other control accounts

• Design and maintain financial policies, controls and approval limits across payments, expenses, procurement and system access

• Oversee AP, AR and cashbook accounting, manage payments through Corepay, and keep an eye on working capital

• Lead statutory accounts and external audits, and oversee VAT, corporate tax and compliance with our tax advisers

• Coordinate intercompany accounting and reporting across our entities in Denmark, Germany, Switzerland and the UK

• Improve finance processes, systems and automation – and over time, build and develop a small accounting team

**What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years in commercially focused accounting roles, ideally with previous experience as a Financial Controller

• A recognised Danish accounting qualification (or equivalent, e.g. ACA, ACCA or CIMA)

• Hands-on experience with subscription and deferred revenue, including month-end revenue reconciliations

• A track record of independently running the month-end close and producing accurate management accounts

• Experience with intercompany balances, foreign currencies and reporting across international subsidiaries

• Exposure to international tax, VAT and transfer pricing, and experience running a local audit process

• A strong grasp of internal controls, segregation of duties and fraud risk

• Experience improving finance operations in a growing, scaling business – and a love for systems and automation

• A sharp eye for detail and the analytical instinct to tell a real business issue from an accounting error

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

jobs.occupation: Optimizing grazing management for biodiversity in semi-natural habitats: evidence from monitoring, remote sensing and field experiments
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027.

Research area and project description:

How can grazing management be optimized to benefit both biodiversity and nature-based beef production? This PhD project will address this question through analyses of long-term biodiversity monitoring data, development of digital biodiversity indicators, and field experiments in Danish semi-natural habitats.

Grazing is a key ecological process in many ecosystems. However, biodiversity outcomes depend on how grazing is managed, including grazing intensity and timing. Despite its widespread use as a conservation tool, important knowledge gaps remain regarding which grazing strategies deliver the greatest biodiversity benefits and how these outcomes can be documented in a robust and scalable way.

The PhD project is part of the interdisciplinary Nature&Beef initiative and will combine ecology, biodiversity monitoring, remote sensing and data science. The selected candidate will work with unique datasets from the Danish national biodiversity monitoring programme (NOVANA), field experiments, drone imagery and other digital monitoring approaches.

The project will focus on four interconnected themes:

• 
Identifying grazing practices associated with positive biodiversity outcomes using long-term monitoring data.

• 
Evaluating the effects of grazing intensity and grazing season on biodiversity in a large-scale field experiment.

• 
Developing and validating image-based indicators of vegetation structure and biodiversity condition from field and drone imagery.

• 
Contributing to the development of AI-based methods for mapping vegetation and habitat condition from drone images.

The project offers an opportunity to contribute to evidence-based conservation and the development of practical tools that can support land managers, farmers, conservation practitioners and value-chain actors in documenting biodiversity outcomes. The findings will help build a stronger scientific foundation for biodiversity-friendly grazing practices and nature-based beef production.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must have a Master’s degree (120 ECTS) in biology or equivalent. The applicants have documented experience in botanical surveys including species identification skills of North-European flora. The applicant must have a driver license applicable in Denmark. Demonstrated proficiency in data management and analysis, image analysis, and experience using R.

Place of employment and place of work:

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C.F. Møllers Allé 8, building 1110, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contacts:

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

Formalities and salary range

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Job Description

**Genmab is committed to transparency of clinical trial research. We recognize the scientific and ethical value of sharing clinical trial information in a non-biased and timely manner to benefit patients and other external stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Disclosure & Transparency (CTD&T) team resides within Clinical Trial Delivery, which hosts key functions for ensuring successful conduct and reporting of clinical trials.

We are now looking for a new Senior Manager to join our CTD&T team. The role offers a meaningful blend of operational and strategic tasks in a collaborative environment where quality, shared purpose, and cross-functional support are central to how we work.

In the role as Senior Manager of CTD&T, you will be executing against the global and national disclosure regulations and requirements across the entire Genmab portfolio. This role engages with internal and external stakeholders to ensure consistent and responsible disclosure and transparency practices. The position requires strong expertise in disclosure requirements and regulatory processes, coupled with strong organizational and communication skills, while maintaining a commitment to quality, integrity, and advancing Genmab’s mission.

**Responsibilities

**Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Manage, track, and maintain overall responsibility for the disclosure of clinical trial protocols and results on ClinicalTrials.gov, EU CTIS, and other applicable registries/platforms.

• Support and provide guidance on redaction activities.

• Ensure development of plain language results summaries.

• Stay updated on industry guidelines to ensure compliance.

• Support in updating SOPs, contribute to process improvements, and maintain adherence to established standards.

• Oversee vendor performance related to transparency deliverables.

• Liaise with clinical CROs to ensure consistent messaging across study registries.

• Deliver training on Genmab’s disclosure processes to internal staff and provide guidance to CROs and vendors as needed.

• Ensure internal teams are informed of updated or new requirements and laws.

• Ensure management of unsolicited requests received via the clinicaltrials@genmab.com mailbox.

**Requirements

**

• 5+ years of clinical trial disclosure experience, including a Bachelor's or Master's degree with relevant specialization

• Strong knowledge of disclosure requirements, technology, and platforms.

• Proven ability to lead projects and facilitate cross-functional collaboration.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, that is effective, respectful, and concise.

• Previous experience as a Medical Writer is advantageous, given the close alignment between the CTD&T and Medical Writing teams.

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$132,800.00---$199,200.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027.

Title:
Optimizing grazing management for biodiversity in semi-natural habitats: evidence from monitoring, remote sensing and field experiments

Research area and project description:
How can grazing management be optimized to benefit both biodiversity and nature-based beef production? This PhD project will address this question through analyses of long-term biodiversity monitoring data, development of digital biodiversity indicators, and field experiments in Danish semi-natural habitats.

Grazing is a key ecological process in many ecosystems. However, biodiversity outcomes depend on how grazing is managed, including grazing intensity and timing. Despite its widespread use as a conservation tool, important knowledge gaps remain regarding which grazing strategies deliver the greatest biodiversity benefits and how these outcomes can be documented in a robust and scalable way.

The PhD project is part of the interdisciplinary Nature&Beef initiative and will combine ecology, biodiversity monitoring, remote sensing and data science. The selected candidate will work with unique datasets from the Danish national biodiversity monitoring programme (NOVANA), field experiments, drone imagery and other digital monitoring approaches.

The project will focus on four interconnected themes:
1) Identifying grazing practices associated with positive biodiversity outcomes using long-term monitoring data.
2) Evaluating the effects of grazing intensity and grazing season on biodiversity in a large-scale field experiment.
3) Developing and validating image-based indicators of vegetation structure and biodiversity condition from field and drone imagery.
4) Contributing to the development of AI-based methods for mapping vegetation and habitat condition from drone images.

The project offers an opportunity to contribute to evidence-based conservation and the development of practical tools that can support land managers, farmers, conservation practitioners and value-chain actors in documenting biodiversity outcomes. The findings will help build a stronger scientific foundation for biodiversity-friendly grazing practices and nature-based beef production.

Qualifications and specific competences:
Applicants to the PhD position must have a Master’s degree (120 ECTS) in biology or equivalent. The applicants have documented experience in botanical surveys including species identification skills of North-European flora. The applicant must have a driver license applicable in Denmark. jobs.occupation: Associate Director - External Data Acquisition Lead (EDAL)
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Associate Director, External Data Acquisition Lead (EDAL) role is a clinical data manager with expertise in the data collection of 3rd party data from various external providers (e.g. laboratories, eCOA providers, technology providers, etc.). The EDAL provides a leadership role in the oversight of the external clinical data integration processes as well as oversight of data quality from various external providers performing testing or data collection services on behalf of Genmab. The EDAL serves as the subject matter expert for all external data management activities performed for clinical trial teams. This role provides strategic data management expertise and is accountable for all end-to-end Data Management activities and deliverables pertaining to external data. The employee will provide oversight of external vendors and the data and/or data services they provide to Genmab. The External Data Lead will support the development and optimization of processes and tools to enable success of the Clinical Operations department. The employee will represent Data Management in Operational Committee’s/fora with the partners and/or DM/stat vendors. The employee will support /train colleagues in and advise on handling of external data management related processes/issues and may act as a mentor. Moreover, the employee shall support the overall strategy and development of Data Management by attending/leading task force initiatives within the department and/or as part of cross-departmental teams.

**Responibilites

**

• Lead external data acquisition across one or more studies/programs, ensuring high-quality, timely, analysis-ready data aligned with trial objectives.

• Influence protocol and amendment development by advising on external data collection design, integration feasibility, and alignment with CDASH/SDTM and EDC requirements.

• Lead planning and oversight of external data flow strategies and DTS across diverse data types (PK/ADA, biomarker, imaging, central lab, eCOA/ePRO, PD, IRT, etc.) to ensure compliant integration.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure external data acquisition supports operational and scientific goals.

• Develop and manage Trial Data Integrity Plans (TDIP) and Data Flow

• Create and maintain data transfer specifications (DTS) requirements. Ensure data collection requirements are aligned with external vendor capabilities and vendor data are compatible with the clinical database and SDTM requirements to support data integration, analysis and reporting. Ensure vendor data is transferred in standard data formats.

• Provide thorough review of external vendors budget and change order

• Act as escalation point for complex vendor issues (timeline deviations, integration challenges, misalignment to trial needs).

• Mentor and guide junior External Data Acquisition Leads, providing direction on best practices, issue resolution, and development.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives including SOP development, process improvement, tools optimization, and external data standards governance.

• Partner with procurement/legal/vendor managers to review technical language in contracts and work orders, ensuring alignment with Genmab standards and systems.

• Promote portfolio-level consistency and scalability through training, knowledge sharing, and strategic planning support.

• Mentor and develop team members to ensure consistency of External Data Management practices.

• Ensure External Vendor deliverables are performed in compliance with protocol, ICH, GCP and SOPs

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in a relevant technical area; Master’s degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in external or clinical data management, with strong third-party vendor oversight and data acquisition experience.

• Experience working on Oncology trials/data

• Experience designing and governing DTS and complex data flows supporting EDC integration and CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM).

• Strong knowledge of diverse external data types (e.g., biomarker, central lab, imaging, eCOA/ePRO, genomic) and ability to align acquisition strategies to clinical and analytical objectives.

• Experience managing projects, vendors, and process improvements in global environments.

• Proven performance in earlier role.

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$157,360.00---$236,040.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

**About You

**

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving

• You are a generous collaborator who can work in teams with a broad spectrum of backgrounds

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to)

• You work hard and are not afraid to have a little fun while you do so!

**Locations

**Genmab maximizes the efficiency of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are crafted as open, community-based spaces that work to connect employees while being immersed in our powerful laboratories. Whether you’re in one of our office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. We actively explore AI tooling to make our data workflows smarter and our team more productive. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

**Your Responsibilities

****Pipeline & Ingestion

**

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

• Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

**Data Platform & Infrastructure

**

• Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

**Data Quality & Governance

**

• Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.

• Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

• Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

**Collaboration & Stakeholders

**

• Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.

• Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

**About The Team

**You'll be joining Spirii's Data Enablement Team, a small, early-stage team formed in January 2026, so you'll have real influence over how things get built from here. The team consists of an Engineering Manager for Data (who you’ll report to), a Data Lead, a Product Manager for Data, and two Analytics Engineers who partner closely with our domain teams. We're in the middle of migrating from Redshift to Databricks and getting our first data products live in production on the new platform: you'll help shape ingestion, orchestration, and reliability standards as we scale.

**About You

**

• You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• You embrace using AI tools to improve data engineering workflows, whether that's using LLMs to accelerate transformation authoring, anomaly detection, or documentation.

• You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience with data observability tooling.

• Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• Experience using AI/LLM tools in a data engineering context

• Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

**Job Description Summary

**The Production Engineer – Calibration & Maintenance is responsible for the calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production, inspection, measurement, and test equipment used in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

The role works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, equipment owners, and external service providers to ensure equipment remains calibrated, maintained, compliant, and available for production.

Responsibilities include day-to-day calibration and preventive maintenance coordination, HxGN EAM administration, calibration assessments, controlled procedures and work instructions, supplier coordination, and equipment compliance.

This is a hands-on Production Engineering role supporting manufacturing operations across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration/loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

**Job Description

****Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Coordinate the site calibration program, including calibration schedules, call-in activities, equipment status, due dates, and timely completion.

• Coordinate internal and external calibration activities, including equipment preparation, shipment, return, documentation review, and release back to production.

• Ensure new, returned, overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment is appropriately assessed and controlled before use.

• Act as SME for calibration and maintenance activities in HxGN EAM, maintaining asset records, calibration setups, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, task plans, and supporting documentation.

• Perform and support calibration assessments, including equipment requirements, criticality, acceptance criteria, calibration methods, frequencies, and maintenance needs.

• Develop and maintain calibration and maintenance procedures, SOPs, and work instructions in collaboration with equipment owners, SMEs, and Quality.

• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for production and test equipment while minimizing disruption to manufacturing.

• Support investigations, risk assessments, and product-impact assessments related to overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment, and provide input to NC/INV/CAPA activities where applicable.

• Coordinate external calibration and maintenance suppliers, including quotations, service activities, documentation, and AGORA purchase orders.

• Support internal and external audits by ensuring calibration and maintenance records are complete, traceable, compliant, and audit-ready.

• Monitor calibration and maintenance performance and drive improvements in equipment compliance, availability, data quality, and execution efficiency.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Metrology, Maintenance, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment management, or Production Engineering in a regulated manufacturing environment.

• Understanding of calibration principles, equipment control, documentation, traceability, and manufacturing process requirements.

• Experience with computerized maintenance or Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably HxGN EAM or comparable systems.

• Experience working within controlled procedures, work instructions, and change management processes.

• Experience coordinating suppliers, service activities, quotations, and purchase orders.

• Knowledge of GMP and Quality Management System requirements within regulated manufacturing.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Experience within medical device manufacturing or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Hands-on and practical approach to supporting manufacturing equipment and production operations.

• Structured working style with strong ownership and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

• Strong collaboration skills across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external suppliers.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable balancing equipment compliance, production continuity, quality requirements, and operational priorities.

• Proactive and improvement-focused approach to equipment reliability and calibration/maintenance processes
